scientific_integrity.computational_scope: Finite independent substitution-count consistency checks, not an infinite proof.
scientific_integrity.proved_scope: Every finite-alphabet two-sided subshift, every positive finite-window real-valued roof, every nonzero real time; fixed-speed word-complexity growth comparison and bounded-doubling equality.

scientific_limitations: No conclusion for arbitrary non-locally-constant continuous roof functions.
Comparison with older variable-roof/generalized-entropy literature is not exhaustive.
The real-time entropy order is not an exact scalar entropy formula when complexity does not have bounded doubling.
title: Locally constant suspension roofs preserve generalized word-growth under bounded doubling
